name: Voyage AI
tagline: High-quality text embeddings and reranking for retrieval applications
description: Voyage AI provides embedding and reranking APIs optimized for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and document ranking. Developers send text or multimodal inputs and receive dense vector embeddings or relevance scores for ranking candidate documents.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header; self-serve signup at dash.voyageai.com

example.request: curl https://api.voyageai.com/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input": ["hello world"], "model": "voyage-3"}'

use_cases: generate text embeddings for semantic search
compare query and document similarity with embeddings
